issues.evidence: spectral_balance_pct mid_1-4k = 11.6% (target ≥15% with VO); sub+low = 56.9%. Per VO window, mid is 8.2% (hook), 9.5% (3.3-6.7), 8.3% (11.4), 11.0% (31.5), 10.1% (34.5), 12.5% (40-45.5), 7.6% (end line); only 'It drives' reaches 49.9%. Low band in the hook VO is 49.3%. Transcription drops words: 'introducing difs in a gentec', end line heard as 'change, reviewable' (match 0.88).
issues.suggested_action: VO chain: HPF 90 Hz, -3 dB at 250 Hz Q1, +3 dB at 3 kHz, then compression. On the music bus, cut 3-4 dB at 1.5-4 kHz keyed by the VO and add a low shelf of -4 dB at 120 Hz during VO.

issues.evidence: Music-only stretches: sub <60 Hz = 36.7% / 32.5% / 35.3%, lowmid only about 5-11%. loudness_curve sits at -17 to -18.5 dBFS for 12 s straight (51.3-63.3) with no movement: the review act is a flat drone.
issues.suggested_action: HPF the music at 35 Hz, apply -3 dB low shelf at 80 Hz, and give the review act a 4-6 dB build from 51.3 to 63.3, starting under -20 dBFS.

issues.evidence: Cue B volume = min(swell 0.4 at s(33-34.5), duck 0.12 during VO 64.4-65.9). The accept swell is clamped to the ducked level exactly at the payoff. Measured 63.3-65.9 ≈ -17 dBFS, the same as the preceding 12 s.
issues.suggested_action: Hit the swell at 63.3-64.3 before the VO, then duck only -6 dB (not -10.4) under 'It drives. You approve.'; or move the VO to 65.0.

issues.evidence: The 'silence' beat starts at -15.8 dBFS (498 impact), louder than the grind average (-24.8 RMS). The grind (13.7-25.3) is the quietest act in the film after the texts, so the arc runs backwards: the tension sits at -25 and the calm review at -17.7.
issues.suggested_action: Raise the grind to about -19 RMS (music A plus foley), keep 28.8-30.4 under -40, and keep the review act at about -21 so the accept and end card can open up.

issues.evidence: cuts_without_sound_event_s lists 15 cuts. At 11.2 (-6.7 dB) and 36.8 (-5.1) the level falls through the cut. Cue A is cut off at 28.8 under an impact rather than ending on a designed stop.
issues.suggested_action: Add 0.3-0.5 s J-cuts on the 11.2 and 36.8 transitions; end cue A on a downbeat at 28.8 with a 30 ms fade and let reverb tail through.

issues.evidence: 0-6.7 has VO plus room tone only; low = 49.3% in the hook window comes from VO body, not score. This is acceptable as a design choice, but the mid share is 8.2%.
issues.suggested_action: Keep it cold, but clean up the VO low-mid (see issue 1).

issues.evidence: -14.6 LUFS integrated (inside ±1), TP -1.8 dBTP (≤ -1.5 OK), LRA 6.9, clipped 0, correlation 0.794.
issues.suggested_action: After the rebalance, run two-pass loudnorm to -14.0 LUFS and keep the limiter ceiling at -1.8.

mix_recipe.vo: HPF 90 Hz 18 dB/oct; -3 dB @250 Hz Q1.0; +3 dB @3 kHz Q0.8; +1.5 dB shelf @10 kHz; comp 3:1, attack 8 ms, release 80 ms, 4-5 dB GR; de-ess 6.5 kHz
mix_recipe.music_duck: sidechain from VO: -6 dB (not -10.4), attack 40 ms, release 300 ms, hold 150 ms; dynamic EQ -3.5 dB @2.5 kHz Q1.2 keyed by VO
mix_recipe.music_eq: HPF 35 Hz; low shelf -3 dB @80 Hz on cue B; cue A unchanged
mix_recipe.swell: cue B to 0.5 (+2 dB) at 63.3-64.3 before the accept VO; duck afterwards
mix_recipe.ambience: HPF 120 Hz on room beds, LPF 6 kHz; night office -42 dBFS, boardroom -40
mix_recipe.sfx_bus: cut ticks peak -12 dBFS; impacts -8 dBFS; LPF transient whooshes at 10 kHz
mix_recipe.loudnorm: pass1: ffmpeg -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.8:LRA=9:print_format=json; pass2 with measured_I/TP/LRA/thresh and linear=true

top_revision: Re-EQ the VO (+3 dB at 3 kHz, -3 dB at 250 Hz) and carve 1-4 kHz plus HPF 35 Hz out of the music, then move the accept swell ahead of 'It drives. You approve.' so mid ≥15% and the payoff is no longer clamped by the duck.
